fields.v: (1) AI-SDLC v1.0.0-beta + coding agent not stated + model not stated (student semester projects, survey n=13). Criterion: none stated by the authors (descriptive survey of student perceptions). Values: Specify sharpened requirements 13/13 agree (11 strongly); structured collaboration 12/13; phases gave orientation 12/13; improved quality 10/13; faster progress 13/13 (9 strongly); would reuse 12/13; overhead in some phases 4/13; adopted code without understanding 6/13 (closed item), 11/13 (free text); following the code among lowest-rated positive items; about half checked quality via PRs (7 agreed); phase usefulness means 3.77-4.42 of 5; NPS answers 7-10, median 8. Quality verdict: no criterion stated by the authors. Cost verdict: no criterion stated by the authors
fields.quote: Given the ordinal scales and the small sample, we report frequency distributions and absolute counts and use no inferential statistics.
fields.why: The authors report only descriptive frequencies and state no success criterion, so under the 2026-11-23 rule the 'partly' quality and cost verdicts are the extractor's own and should be 'no criterion stated by the authors'.
fields.doubt: Os autores só dão frequências descritivas e não definem nenhum critério de sucesso. Pela regra de 23/11, os veredictos 'partly' (qualidade e custo) são juízo teu; devem passar a 'no criterion stated by the authors', mantendo os valores. Confirma na §3.2 (pág. 5).
